title: Support Case Insights optional CDK Pipelines configuration
description: Opt-in configuration for config/pipeline.json. It is validated separately from config/<env>.json and never changes standalone 'cdk deploy --all -c env=<env>' behaviour.
$comment: Cross-file rules enforced by lib/config/pipeline.ts: config/dev.json and config/prod.json must declare environment dev and prod, use different uniqueId values, share orgId, and both managementAccountId values must equal account. The connection ARN must be in the same account.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema.

account.description: Management account that hosts the pipeline and both deployment stages.

connectionArn.description: ARN of an existing, human-authorised AWS CodeConnections connection to GitHub. No personal access tokens are used.

repository.description: GitHub owner/repository used as the pipeline source.

branch.description: Source branch. Only main is supported.
